name: tour-chapters
title: Tour chapters
description: A product video with its chapters beside it: pick a topic and the video jumps there and plays, with each start time written out.
docs: Pass title, src (one address, or several files of different formats), poster, captions (a WebVTT address), transcriptHref and chapters, each with a start in seconds, a title and an optional description (two lines of it are shown, the rest is cut with an ellipsis). The video is a native player with controls and a captions track, and only its first frames and its length are fetched until someone plays it. Beside it, every chapter is a button named like "Chapter 3 of 6, 1:42, Invite your team": a click, a tap, Enter or Space jumps to that time and plays. The chapter the video is in is marked (its time turns solid, its row is filled and a hairline fills along it, and it carries aria-current), and the list keeps it in view without moving the page. The arrow keys, Home and End move between chapters. On a wide screen the list is as tall as the player and scrolls, and its scroll box is not a tab stop of its own (the chapters are the stops); on a phone it follows the player at full length, and picking a chapter far down it scrolls the player back into view, so the jump is seen. onChapterSelect reports the chapter a visitor picks, and labels carries the fixed words for another language.
